name: cyberark
label: CyberArk
description: Manage users, groups, and access controls in CyberArk Privileged Access Management

delete_user.label: Delete User
delete_user.description: Deletes a specific user in the Vault (requires Add/Update Users authorization)

userId.label: User
userId.description: The ID of the Vault user to delete.

confirmDeletion.label: Confirm Deletion
confirmDeletion.description: Check this box to confirm you want to delete the selected user. This action cannot be undone.

delete_user.afterResponse: return { success: true, message: `User ${inputs.userId} deleted successfully` };

remove_member_from_group.label: Remove Member from Group
remove_member_from_group.description: Removes a specific user from a user group in the Vault

groupId.label: Group
groupId.description: The ID of the Vault user group.

memberId.label: Member
memberId.description: The Vault user name or LDAP group name to remove from the group.

remove_member_from_group.afterResponse: return { success: true, message: `Successfully removed ${inputs.memberId} from group ${inputs.groupId}` };
